growthBrief.opportunityTitle: Linear has no ABM layer and thin campaign LP coverage — marketing iteration is eng-gated, leaving ICP conversion on the table at $100M ARR scale

rationaleBlocks.title: The gap
bullets: Linear's site is a **custom-coded Next.js build** — beautiful, but marketing cannot self-serve LP changes without eng.
No visible **ABM instrumentation**: one generic homepage serves all ICPs (devs, PMs, CTOs, enterprise buyers).
**Zero localised landing pages** detected for non-EN markets despite a distributed team spanning North America and Europe.
Paid and outbound campaigns point to the generic homepage — no **dedicated campaign LP** layer observed.

rationaleBlocks.title: The math
bullets: Roughly **25,000 teams** on platform; even 0.1% incremental tier-upgrade lift from personalised ABM LPs = ~25 accounts/month.
Average enterprise ACV rough estimate **~$8–15K/yr** (seat-based Plus/Enterprise tiers at ~$15–20/seat × 50–100 seats).
25 incremental accounts × **€600 avg MRR** = ~**€15,000/month** conservatively; scale to 40 accounts with Localization Agent = ~€24K/mo.
Prismic platform cost at this scale: **~€1,500–3,000/mo** — strong ROI multiple on a single ABM cohort.

rationaleBlocks.title: What Prismic Agents ship
bullets: **ABM Agent** generates named-account pages from reverse-IP detection — no eng sprint per variant.
**SEO Agent** identifies thin solution/comparison pages (e.g. 'Linear vs Jira') and rewrites for search intent at scale.
**Localization Agent** spins regional variants (DE, FR, JP) for Linear's European and APAC expansion segments.
**Paid Ads Agent** syncs LP copy to ad creative — removes the message-match gap burning Linear's (currently minimal) paid budget.

rationaleBlocks.title: Why now
bullets: Linear hit **$100M ARR** and is moving upmarket toward enterprise — ABM motion is the natural next growth lever.
Competitor Atlassian runs **hundreds of ABM LP variants**; Linear's single-page approach is a moat risk as it scales.
Team grew from ~100 to **~200 employees** in under 18 months — marketing headcount is expanding but tooling hasn't kept pace.
**$134M raised**, $1.25B valuation — board pressure to show repeatable demand-gen beyond PLG word-of-mouth is real.

quickWins.text: **Build** a single ABM variant targeting 'CTO at Series B SaaS' via reverse-IP and **measure** demo-request CVR lift vs. the generic homepage within 1 week.
**Audit** the top 5 'Linear vs Jira / Asana / Monday' pages with Prismic's SEO Agent and **track** organic ranking movement on head comparison keywords within 2 weeks.
**Ship** a German-language LP variant for the DACH segment using Localization Agent and **measure** trial signup rate against the EN baseline for EU visitors.
**Gate** a Prismic-powered solution page for 'Enterprise PM teams' behind a Clearbit/HubSpot enrichment trigger and **report** MQL-to-SQL velocity change over one sprint.
**Route** all outbound LinkedIn and Google paid traffic to message-matched Prismic LPs (via Paid Ads Agent) and **measure** 30-day CAC reduction vs. current homepage-destination campaigns.
